acceptanceCriteria: dogfood-change runs the guarding-test search by default (or records why it cannot)
K1 re-tallied over the next 30 Go-code changes with held counts per hunk
Retire or keep decision recorded from that tally
body: Found by the V1-1266 lane (PR #1286, head 6e7387505). K1 fired (0 held) but none of the sampled test-claim citations came from --guarding-tests; internal/dogfoodflow reports guarding-tests-not-run without running it. Decision (orchestrator, under the 2026-10-05 delegation): keep --hunk-revert and --guarding-tests as opt-in steps, not retired, and re-measure K1 once dogfood-change runs the guarding-test search by default. Expected: a fresh 30-change window after that switch.
title: Re-measure K1 after dogfood-change runs the guarding-test search automatically
